name: desire for food
description: Physical or mental desire to eat.

guidance.description: Dieting and breaking diets is common. You probably know whether it's time to seek help.

variations.name: biological hunger
variations.description: Hunger is an uncomfortably empty feeling in the belly driving you to seek nourishment.

variations.name: clock says hungry
variations.description: Often in the modern world, we're ready to eat mostly because the clock says it's time for a meal and you're ready for a break from work. Often these breaks are cherished parts of the day.
perceptions: I'm not necessarily hungry, but it's time to eat.

variations.name: social appetite
variations.description: A desire for food caused by watching others eat.
perceptions: I'm not necessarily hungry, but other are eating and enjoying themselves.
I'd fit in better if I were eating too.
desires: desire to be perceived a certain way
examples: Watching an advertisement that shows happy people eating.

commentaries.quote: It may be helpful to be aware of why you're heading to the refrigerator: boredom, anxiety, social bonding, or actual hunger.
A hungry man can't see right or wrong. He just sees food.
There are people in the world so hungry, that God cannot appear to them except in the form of bread.
The belly is an ungrateful wretch, it never remembers past favors, it always wants more tomorrow.
To a hungry person, every bitter food is sweet. When the preferable is not available, the available becomes preferable!
